plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Bob Lazar, a man who claims he worked on alien craft at a secret site in Nevada, admits he may have been made to drink a liquid and then fed information. According to Michels, that information looked like the same material that Richard Doty, an Air Force intelligence agent, passed in 1979 in New Mexico to Linda Moulton Howe, a journalist, and Paul Bennewitz, a businessman who believed he had picked up alien signals, which, if true, would suggest Lazar's story was partly planted by the government's own false leads.
